data.name: Allergen check
data.goal: The caller knows whether their order is suitable for their allergy, based on the allergen list, not a guess.
data.when: The caller mentions a food allergy or a dietary restriction.
data.guidance:
Watch for this: answered the allergy question without the allergen list.

If the caller asks whether a dish is safe, tell them what the allergen list shows and that everything is made in a shared kitchen. Don't reassure them, and don't describe the kitchen as free of any allergen.

steps.text: Ask who the allergy is for and what it is
Name the specific allergen back to the caller
Check each item the caller ordered against {{menu_allergen_link}}

never.text: Never say an item is "allergen-free" or "safe"
Never place the order before allergens are confirmed

warning_signs.text: The caller mentions anaphylaxis or an EpiPen; transfer to {{staff_transfer}}
